method: Compared local capture timestamp, original URL, SHA-256, title, article text, visible comment count, image references, and navigation labels. The raw source bytes were not modified. October 17 entries additionally record exact homepage-linked Squarespace assets and the separate resource-specific compatibility review. Resource-specific image substitutions from the same Squarespace site are recorded separately in source/asset-aliases.json and verified by capture timestamp and SHA-256 during every build.
